verdict.rationale: Honeybadger cuts some noise by grouping identical errors and allowing custom fingerprints, and a user praises the deduping. Threshold-based alarms and baseline anomaly detection mean alerts can fire on unusual volume rather than on every occurrence. Missing for 10: spike protection or quota throttling during error floods, per-key or per-project rate limits, explicit mute/ignore/snooze rules for errors or notifications, and any hands-on evidence that these controls stop overnight paging after a bad deploy.
